seoTitle: Microphone Test: Level Meter, Record and Play Back
metaDescription: Check that your microphone works: pick the input, watch a live level meter, record five seconds and play it back. Audio stays on your device.
intro: Find out whether your mic works and how loud it is before a call or recording.
why:
After you allow access, the page shows the available inputs, a live meter in dBFS with the loudest level so far and a plain-language hint (too quiet, near clipping, fine). Recording uses the browser's MediaRecorder for five seconds and plays the clip back in a player; nothing is sent over the network.

Use headphones for playback to avoid feedback. Browsers only show device names after you grant permission.

No data is sent anywhere: the work happens in your browser, so you can use it offline once the page has loaded.
howTo: Press Start and allow the microphone.
Record five seconds and play it back.
Choose another input if the level is zero.

faq.q: Why is the level very low?
faq.a: Wrong input selected, muted device, or input gain set too low in the system settings.
